exact_claim: Across MNAR Tables 2-3, MSNN consistently attains 3-26% feasible rates versus under 5% for SNN, with 2-3x error reductions across treatment levels.
falsification_rule: The conjunction is FALSIFIED if the pinned paper tables themselves contain MSNN feasible rates above 26%, SNN feasible rates above 5%, or SNN/MSNN values labeled MRE outside the closed 2x-to-3x interval. The metric portion is independently falsified if the table values reproduce under released-code normalized MAE but not under Section 5.1's per-entry relative-error formula.
non_circularity: Dimensions, rank, two lambda values, three treatments, ten seeds, all-entry target set, noise, PCR threshold, feasibility thresholds, paper absolute-entry DGP, and both metric formulas were pinned from the paper and source before formal output. The assignment-proportion calibration tested competing source interpretations without running the imputation outcome.
